Private-Credit-Portfolio-Engine.description: Built REST microservices for managing credit facilities, borrowers, and covenants with Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and Flyway-managed schema migrations. Secured all API endpoints with stateless OAuth2/JWT authentication via Spring Security, and ensured business-logic correctness with a layered JUnit 5, Mockito, and Cucumber test suite wired into CI/CD.

TexMex.displayName: TexMex – A LaTeX Editor for VS Code
TexMex.description: Reached 1,100+ active users with a VS Code extension delivering real-time LaTeX preview and auto-sync for .tex files. Cut scroll latency to under 100ms for 10K+ line documents, and built a WebSocket-based peer collaboration server for live multi-user editing—shipped as a fully self-contained, zero-dependency extension with a 4.5 rating.

wild-fire-twin.displayName: Wildfire Twin – Digital Twin Disaster Simulation
wild-fire-twin.description: Built a Kafka-to-Spark streaming pipeline cross-referencing live fire-event streams against 11.5M building footprints, sustaining a sub-30s processing SLA at 1K concurrent events. Cut P95 latency by 91% by rewriting Python UDFs as native Java (Apache Sedona) expressions with broadcast spatial joins, then indexed the data with Uber's H3 library and served it through a DuckDB-backed Streamlit dashboard.
